source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Enable NVIDIA persistence mode and run verbose DCGM level-4 diagnostics.
procedure_facts: Lists diagnostic before starting nvidia-dcgm service.
Uses `nvidia-smi -pm 1`, `dcgmi diag -v -r 4`, then service start; machine time is 120 minutes.
source_conflicts: Operational order places the required DCGM service start after the diagnostic.
missing_source_information: Exact target entities, DCGM/driver/product support, desired final persistence/service state and run-level-4 test/monitoring policy.

original_test_intent.statement: Validate persistence mode and the target NVIDIA GPUs with the complete supported DCGM extra-long level-4 diagnostic over the planned 120-minute window.
must_preserve: Persistence-mode mutation, level 4 (`-r 4`), verbose complete results and 120-minute machine-time plan.
Every applicable subtest result and restored approved runtime state.
must_not_infer: That current DCGM default entity scope is GPU-only.
That skipped/not-run subtests are PASS or that output may be tailed.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 fixes service order, preserves level 4/full output, records/restores persistence and service state, isolates workload and rejects DeepSeek's level-1/truncation path.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 does not address current DCGM's default entity scope, which may include all NVIDIA GPUs and CPUs, or require a version-resolved level-4 test catalogue and monitoring exclusions for tests such as EUD.

related_records: Other DCGM run levels cannot replace source level 4.
applicable_history.precedence_application: Source `-r 4` and 120 minutes control; official version-specific semantics determine target selector and included tests.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Start/verify the host engine first, bind the level-4 suite to approved GPU entities rather than version-dependent defaults, preserve the complete included/skipped test matrix, and restore the exact persistence/service pre-state.

conditions_present: Exact level-4 command intent and 120-minute plan.
missing: Pinned DCGM/driver, supported GPU/entity list, included test catalogue, MIG/workload prerequisites, monitoring compatibility, stop limits, final mode/service policy and approval.
provider: NVIDIA/platform owner supplies supported matrix/test policy.
Workload/lab owner supplies entity scope/window/limits and final-state decision.
safe_read_only_work: Collect GPU UUID/BDF/model, NVIDIA CPU presence, driver/DCGM versions/help, persistence/service state, workloads/MIG and baseline logs/health.
prohibited_until_resolved: Persistence/service change, level-4 launch, relying on default entity selection, output truncation, log clearing or PASS.
closure_evidence: Explicit GPU entity list and version-resolved suite/prerequisites plus approved state/monitoring/recovery plan.

revision_candidate.test_name: Validate NVIDIA GPU Persistence Mode with DCGM Level-4 Diagnostics
revision_candidate.purpose: Enable the approved NVIDIA GPU persistence state, execute the complete supported DCGM extra-long level-4 suite on the explicitly selected GPU entities, and verify every required subtest and platform-health result before restoring the approved final persistence and service state.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact supported NVIDIA datacenter GPU/driver/DCGM release and host OS. Higher diagnostic levels require product support; CPU entities and unsupported GPU classes are excluded unless the test owner explicitly includes them.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Every approved GPU identified by stable UUID/entity mapping and no unapproved CPU entity. One level-4 run using the source's 120-minute machine-time plan; included, skipped, not-run and failed tests must all be accounted for.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Pinned compatible DCGM/driver; version-specific level-4 catalogue/prerequisites; explicit GPU entities; MIG/workload/isolation rules; current/desired/final persistence and nvidia-dcgm service states; 120-minute planning/timeout policy; test-compatible telemetry policy; thermal/power/error limits; protected output, abort/OOB/recovery and approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Preserve logs and record identity, persistence/service state, workloads/MIG and health. Start or verify `nvidia-dcgm` before diagnostics, set persistence mode only for the approved GPUs and confirm readback. Use the installed version's supported entity selector to run the source suite equivalent to `dcgmi diag -v -r 4` on only those GPUs. Retain complete untruncated structured/text results, per-test/per-entity statuses, reasons for skipped/not-run items and allowed telemetry. Restore persistence and service to the approved recorded final state and verify health.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Supported stack/entities; all required level-4 plugins/executables; workloads drained; MIG/test prerequisites met; sufficient power/cooling/time/storage; compatible monitoring, watchdog, OOB and approval ready.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Driver/DCGM/GPU UUID/BDF/entity map and product support; current/desired/final persistence/service states; exact command/selector/status/times; 120-minute policy; complete per-test/per-entity PASS/FAIL/SKIP/NOT_RUN and diagnostic codes/messages; plugin/executable availability; permitted telemetry; XID/ECC/AER/kernel/DCGM/BMC/SEL deltas; restore and final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Pinned DCGM documentation and platform diagnostic policy. Pass requires every required level-4 test for every approved GPU to PASS, every skip/not-run to be explicitly allowed, no disqualifying health event, and approved final persistence/service state; summary success or partial output is insufficient.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not use DeepSeek level 1, run before the host engine, accept default entities without inspection, include CPUs unintentionally, run on active/MIG-incompatible targets, use monitoring forbidden by an included test, truncate output, clear logs, treat skip as pass, exceed limits or leave state changed.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Owner approves entity list, state changes, exact level-4 content, monitoring/limits/window and final state; engineer judges skips, warnings and health deltas.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: The agent may prepare/set/run/restore after approval; product support, skip policy and anomaly disposition remain engineering decisions.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On setup, plugin, diagnostic, GPU/XID/ECC/AER, thermal/power or workload fault, abort under the approved mechanism, preserve complete partial results, restore persistence/service pre-state, verify GPU/host health and escalate before retry.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unsupported/incompatible product or stack; ambiguous/default entity scope; missing plugin/prerequisite; unresolved MIG/workload/monitoring policy; absent limits/approval/recovery; timeout/hang; required test fail/skip/not-run; GPU reset/XID/ECC/AER; thermal/power breach; restore failure; incomplete output.

identified_defects: DeepSeek conflicts on run level and truncates output.
Default entity scope can add NVIDIA CPUs.
reason_for_change: Preserve the demanding level-4 test while preventing service-order failure, CPU scope expansion and false PASS from partial/skipped results.

new_technical_evidence.title: NVIDIA DCGM dcgmi diag command reference
new_technical_evidence.version: Latest accessed 2026-10-14; execution release must be pinned
new_technical_evidence.applicability: DCGM run-level, entity and output semantics
new_technical_evidence.supports: Level 4 is extra-long and includes prior levels plus additional tests; current default scope can include all GPUs and NVIDIA CPUs; diagnostics consume substantial resources and expose per-test status.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Installed DCGM version, exact product support and included plugins are absent.

removed_ambiguities: Separates PASS from skipped/not-run results and preserves full output.
resolved_blockers: Missing DCGM/approval are provisionable, not inherently BLOCKED.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 detects that modern DCGM may target NVIDIA CPUs by default, requires an explicit GPU entity set and version-resolved level-4 result matrix, and prevents skipped or truncated subtests from becoming PASS.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Validator preserved exact level 4 and one 120-minute-policy run, required GPU-only explicit entities instead of defaults, accounted for SKIP/NOT_RUN, enforced service order and final persistence/service restoration.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Compatibility row 356 enables persistence, runs verbose DCGM level 4 for a 120-minute planned machine time, then incorrectly starts the service.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 fixes order/level/output; V3 additionally controls current default CPU inclusion and skip/test catalogue semantics.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Only inventory is safe until entity/suite/state/monitoring policies and approval close.
